text:
incident-bot: ALERT: High 5xx rate detected on dedicated cluster redwood-dedicated-us-east-1 (svc: embeddings). Error spike started ~1768807700, p95 latency rising. Affected customer: Evergreen Capital (dedicated pool ID: dk-evg-02). Paging on-call. :rotating_light:

alex_oncall: acknowledged. I'm on it — will triage error traces and isolate if it's a routing or runtime issue. Paging SRE lead.

olivia_sre: on my way. Initial check: autoscaler healthy, GPUs not OOM, tailing `runtime.log` shows repeated `KVCacheMiss` + `quantize` errors from worker-3. Dumping last 200 lines.

alex_oncall: thanks. alex_oncall here — assigning mitigation owner: @bharat_runtime to verify kernel/quantization path for this model variant. If we can't clear quickly, fallback policy for Evergreen is `hosted-fallback` (partner-hosted model) — need approval from acct.

bharat_runtime: looking now. quick grep shows `failed to load quantization metadata` on startup for worker-3: ``
2026-06-10T14:12:34Z worker-3 ERROR model_loader: failed to read quant_meta: EOF
``
I'll attempt `systemctl restart redwood-runtime@worker-3` and rehydrate caches.

alex_oncall: go ahead. Also keep logs. Jordan, can you draft a short customer notification and get AM looped?

jordan_support: drafting now. tagging @maya_acct for account-level contacts and approval.

maya_acct: paging in — we need a tailored impact statement for Evergreen. Quick contact list: Primary AM: Maya Chen (maya@redwood.ai), Technical Liaison: Luis Torres (luis.t@evergreencap.com), Security: Raj Patel (raj@evergreencap.com). Evergreen uses embeddings heavily for internal search and fraud detection; they will see degraded embedding generation and occasional 5xxs across their app routes.

jordan_support: DRAFT CUSTOMER NOTE (for Evergreen Capital — please review):
Hi Luis / Evergreen team,

We detected elevated 5xx errors and increased latency in your dedicated embeddings pool (dk-evg-02) starting ~14:12 UTC. Our on-call team is investigating; initial signs point to a runtime quantization metadata load failure on one worker which is causing request retries and higher tail latency.

Impact: Intermittent embedding generation failures and degraded query/retrieval quality for internal search/fraud tooling. No data loss observed; requests may experience retries or timeouts.

Mitigation being performed: restarting affected runtime worker, rehydrating KV cache, and applying a transient fallback policy to route new requests to a compatible hosted model variant while we verify stability.

ETA: we expect restoration within 20–40 minutes; we will send updates every 15 minutes or when status changes.

If you need immediate assistance, contact Maya Chen (maya@redwood.ai) or our incident channel.

Please confirm you want us to enable the hosted fallback while we fix the worker.

maya_acct: LGTM. Evergreen says enable fallback ASAP — they've confirmed via phone.

bharat_runtime: restarted worker-3: `systemctl restart` completed. Observed rehydrate logs:
``
2026-06-10T14:14:05Z worker-3 INFO model_loader: quant_meta loaded (size: 84kb)
2026-06-10T14:14:21Z worker-3 INFO cache: kv cache warmup complete
```
Traffic shows initial drop in errors. Continuing to monitor.

olivia_sre: monitoring p95/p99 and 5xx rate. Setting an alert if 5xx>0.5% sustained for 5m.

statusbot: STATUS PAGE DRAFT — for approval from comms/SRE:
Title: Degraded embedding generation for Evergreen Capital (Dedicated pool dk-evg-02)
Summary: We are investigating elevated error rates and latency affecting a dedicated embeddings pool serving a single enterprise customer. Some requests are intermittently failing with 5xx.
Impact: Evergreen Capital may experience intermittent failures when generating embeddings and higher latency for search-related requests.
Mitigation: We have restarted the affected runtime worker and temporarily routed new requests to a hosted-compatible model variant for continuity. Our engineering team is monitoring and will revert routing once stability is confirmed.
ETA: Monitoring; next update in 15 minutes.

alex_oncall: approved. post it. Jordan — send Evergreen the approved note.

jordan_support: posted status (https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/1768807777) and sent customer email to luis@evergreencap.com — included log excerpt, mitigation steps, and contact list.

bharat_runtime: error rate back down to baseline (5xx ~0.05%). Worker-3 stable for 6 mins. No further quant_meta failures in logs.

olivia_sre: verifying end-to-end: embeddings ingestion queue normalizing, p99 latency returning to normal. Locking fallback off in 5 minutes if stable.

maya_acct: Evergreen confirmed recovery on their side, search flows look normal. Requested a follow-up RCA and whether this is recurring.

alex_oncall: great. action items: (1) bharat to run `model_loader` extended validation job (2) olivia to schedule post-incident RCA doc (3) maya to send customer follow-up with RCA timeline and offer 1:1 bridge if they want.

bharat_runtime: will run validation job and share results in #eng-runtime.

olivia_sre: creating RCA draft now and will attach logs and mitigation timeline.

statusbot: UPDATE: Elevated error rates mitigated; worker restart resolved the immediate failure. Monitoring continues.

alex_oncall: closing pager. If anything recurs, reopen thread. Thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
